job.title: HR Business Partner
job.description:
HR Business Partner

Christchurch | South Island Focus | Permanent

About the Company

Our client is a well-established South Island business operating within the commercial construction space. With more than 25 years of industry experience and a reputation for delivering high-quality service across a range of commercial and industrial environments, they have built a strong and loyal customer base throughout the region.

About the Role

This is a rare opportunity to establish and shape the HR function within a growing South Island business, partnering with leaders while driving both strategic and operational HR initiatives.

As the sole HR professional, you'll take ownership of the full employee lifecycle while developing the systems, processes, and people initiatives that support long-term growth. Working closely with tradespeople, apprentices, frontline leaders, and senior management, you'll be a trusted advisor across all areas of HR.

This is a hands-on role with plenty of autonomy, suited to someone who enjoys creating structure, building capability, and making a genuine impact across a business.

Key Responsibilities

·       Own the full employee lifecycle, including recruitment, onboarding, performance management and offboarding

·       Lead recruitment across trade, operational and professional roles, managing agency and labour hire relationships

·       Support workplace health and safety activities, training requirements, and incident management

·       Provide advice and support on employee relations, performance, conduct and people matters

·       Manage employee records, employment agreements and HR administration

·       Develop and improve HR policies, procedures, systems and processes

·       Coordinate training, certifications, workforce planning and retention initiatives

About You

We're looking for a confident and approachable HR professional who enjoys building strong relationships and providing practical, commercially focused advice.

·       Previous experience in a HR Business Partner or Senior HR Advisor position

·       Strong knowledge of New Zealand employment legislation

·       Excellent stakeholder management and coaching skills

·       Experience within construction, manufacturing, or another operational environment will be highly regarded

What's on Offer

·       Own and shape the HR function in a standalone role

·       Lead career pathways, leadership development, and engagement programs

·       Supportive leadership team with a collaborative, down-to-earth culture

·       Competitive salary and the opportunity to leave a lasting impact on the business

·       Opportunity to influence people practices, performance, engagement, and culture

Apply Now

If you're an experienced HR professional looking for a role where you can genuinely partner with leaders and make a meaningful impact on organisational culture and performance, we'd love to hear from you.

Get in touch with Victoria victoriae@tech5.co.nz or 027 303 5967

job.title: Class 2 Driver / Civil Labourer
job.description:
About the Role:
  • Join Tech 5 and get assigned to work with a well-established, award-winning civil construction firm with a strong regional presence and a proven track record in roading maintenance.
  • Work alongside a supportive team of positive people, operating well-maintained machinery and upholding excellent health and safety standards.
  • Contribute to maintenance and improvement of the roading network across the Top of the South, supporting government investment in critical infrastructure.
  • Flexible casual engagement aligned with current (very large!) workload
 
What You’ll Do:
  • Assist with day‑to‑day site activities: material delivery, loading/unloading, site housekeeping, and aiding crew with tasks as required like digging, raking, spotting for vehicles, and more.
  • Operate light trucks and assist with traffic management and temporary works where qualified and trained.
  • Drive and position vehicles and trailers as needed, maintaining safe loading practices and securement of loads.
  • Read site plans, risk assessments, and traffic management plans; communicate effectively with crew and supervisors.
  • Conduct basic equipment checks on the vehicle you operate and assist with basic maintenance tasks under supervision.
  • Adhere to health and safety protocols, promote safe work practices, and contribute to a positive safety culture.
 
What We’re Looking For:
  • Current full Class 2 truck licence (NZ) with a clean driving record and demonstrated responsible, safe driving.
  • Willingness to perform physical, hands-on labour and to assist with a range of tasks on civil sites.
  • Reliability, punctuality and a positive, team-oriented attitude.
  • Ability to follow instructions, work in varying weather conditions, and adapt to changing priorities on site.
  • Basic understanding of site safety and traffic management is helpful; training can be provided for specific site requirements.
 
Nice-to-Haves (not essential, but will help you with a higher rate):
  • Experience supporting civil construction or road maintenance teams.
  • Tickets or certifications related to civil construction or traffic management.
  • A valid driver’s licence beyond Class 2 (e.g., Class 1) and readiness to drive company vehicles as part of the role.
 
If You Don’t Have Additional Tickets Yet:
  • If you have a full Class 2 licence and the motivation to work in civil construction, we encourage you to apply. We’re open to helping you and look for pathways and opportunities to develop your skills on real projects with a supportive team.
 
What We Offer:
  • A positive, team-focused work environment with well-maintained equipment and strong positive leadership.
  • Competitive rates with potential for longer-term opportunities as workload and client requirements evolve.
  • Access to support and training to hone and further your skills from us and on our client’s sites.
  • The chance to contribute to critical roading maintenance projects funded by local and central government.
 
How to Apply:
  • Please submit your resume detailing your work and driving experience, and any relevant site exposure.
  • Include a brief note about your availability, current location in the Top of the South, and why you’re excited about contributing to roading maintenance.
 
We’re an equal opportunity employer and value diversity. If you’re ready to bring your dedication, teamwork, and safety-first attitude to us and our selection of well-respected civil construction clients, we’d love to hear from you.
The ball is in your court. We want to represent you and help you achieve your career goals. You could be a Labourer wanting to become an Operator, or an Operator wanting to become a Foreman. We want to hear where you’ve come from and where you are headed.

If you feel you are the right person for the job, or would like further information, reply directly or call Monique or Daan during office hours for more information on (03) 543 8106.

job.description:

  • Completing company training and being signed off as competent to operate the pilot ute.
 
What we're looking for:
  • Full Class 1 NZ Driver Licence.

  • Confident operating a pilot ute and its warning equipment/signage.
  • Able to pass a Ministry of Justice (MOJ) check.
  • Able to pass a pre-employment drug test.
  • Must have the right to work in New Zealand.
 
If you have experience working around road maintenance or traffic management and are confident driving in an active roadwork environment, we'd like to hear from you.
 
Apply now!
